Question:
What solid is formed when a right triangle is rotated through one full revolution about one of its legs?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_052_q1_question_en.svg)
Solution: When a right triangle is rotated through one full revolution about one of its legs, the hypotenuse sweeps out the lateral surface of a cone, and the other leg sweeps out the base, forming a cone.
